summary: Current main already contains the primary producer-side no-init fix from merged PR #32467. The real GPU-input plan_prefill path emitted no out-of-bound ragged_id values in 6000 issue-shaped calls on gfx950; no production change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual GPU-input DSV4 c128 plan_prefill output for [4]*96, [4]*72+[3]*24, and [3]*104+[2]*24. Measured max emitted ragged_id against the independent sum(extend_lens)-1 bound: 0/6000 bad plans.
Existing DSV4 host/GPU planner agreement and ring residency boundaries: 5 tests, 82 subtests passed.

tests.command: Temporary restoration of the five lines removed by 8549cce11b878d2fbf814d5e27bcc5e626890e70, then the same 2000-call-per-shape harness with an isolated JIT cache
tests.what_was_measured: Historical-source negative control on gfx950: 0/6000 bad plans, so the architecture-sensitive old race was not reproduced in this environment. Source was restored afterward.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. The regression passes GPU-resident seq_lens and extend_lens through the actual JIT plan_prefill implementation; raw output is in reports/j-175f4598fc85/raw/.

remaining_limitations: No B300/B30Z or CUDA 13 hardware was available.
Only one GPU was assigned, so TP8 and cross-rank behavior were not exercised.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-DSpark weights were unavailable; full server startup, graph capture, replay, semantic accuracy, and host SIGSEGV modes were not tested.
The historical five-line variant did not reproduce its scheduling race on gfx950, so failing-before evidence remains the upstream B300 direct harness rather than this environment.
Open PRs #33795 and #34286 concern separate Full/Breakable CUDA Graph capture-ordering boundaries and were not treated as the primary producer fix.
